propositions: Six files in src/rebar are at or near the 800-LOC hard cap (786–800 lines) with no existing owner, creating a queue of latent CI failures for any contributor who adds code to these files.
The module-size gate has no allowlist and the 800-LOC limit is locked, so any edit to a file at 799–800 LOC, including comments, fails the build.

Files must be split along existing logical concerns and architectural call-graph seams, not mechanically carved, and resulting files must have real headroom (target 200–500 LOC each, none under 100 LOC).
Behaviour must be preserved: existing tests covering affected areas must pass unmodified, and any registries or line-budgets keyed to moved symbols must be updated in the same change as the move.
The recorded census is stale due to intervening merges; the next session must re-measure against current origin/main before selecting extraction targets.
